versions.changelog:
ima-knowledge-base 1.0.0

- Initial release of Tencent IMA Knowledge Base skill.
- Supports both OpenAPI (Client ID + API Key) and Cookie authentication methods.
- Provides complete interface for knowledge base management, note CRUD operations, RAG Q&A, folder management, and subscribed knowledge base management.
- Includes detailed instructions for quick setup, environment configuration, and sample code for both authentication methods.
- Lists full API endpoints and common troubleshooting tips.
